text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Welcome back, Tran-san~.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: I'm baack, Accu-sa—... Wait, what!?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Huh...? That on the desk... could it be 
that ultra-compact notebook I lost the 
lottery for...!?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
On that cassette site, Tran-san, you 
entered the giveaway, right? They say it's 
pretty hard to win, though.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I borrowed Tarumae-chan's phone and 
submitted an entry myself while she 
explained how to apply~

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Huh, whoa. Seriously? For me? Wait a 
second, geez...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"Ehh~~~! Hey, hey, come ooon~~! Just a 
'thank you' isn't nearly enough for this!"

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. I'm so happy to see them this 
delighted. I'll have to make sure to thank 
Tarumae-chan as well~.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
I kept saying thank you until the very 
second I went to sleep. I sent a thank-you 
message to Tarumae-chan right away, too.

Listening to an unusually hyped-up 
Transcend, I nodded in shared excitement.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Mm. My heart already feels so warm.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, exactly. I've been thinking about it 
all day, but nothing really hits the spot.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Hell yeah. Good to be working with you, 
Trai-chan~.

"Training had just wrapped up. Once 
Transcend changed, I decided to go browse 
the shops with her."

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, cosmetics, huh... Stuff like this 
really depends on skin type too.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Clothes are a matter of personal taste, 
too. I have some idea of what she likes, 
but they can get pretty pricey, and it 
might feel like too heavy a gift...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Sweets are the obvious choice, huh~? It's 
a safe bet, sure, but this is...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Totally~.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
...You know, when I got that surprise, my 
heart really went all 'squeee~', I gotta 
say.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Just a passing comment, you know? I 
overheard you saying you wanted one and 
hoped you'd win.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"Secretly struggling through an unfamiliar 
application form just because they wanted 
to make me happy."

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Knowing they were thinking of me really 
kind of hit me right in the feels.

My heart, my feelings are overwhelmingly 
happy. I agree with what her eyes are 
saying. Transcend, too, surely wants to 
bring joy to Wonder Acute.
In that case—
choice_data_list:
How about something that would surprise 
her?

Maybe it doesn't have to be a physical 
thing

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: ...Something surprising.

A surprise for a surprise. If I think of 
it as gifting Wonder Acute a 'pleasant 
shock'...
choice_data_list: Is it too difficult, I wonder?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Whoa, is that a provocation~?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
...Still, I see. I hadn't considered that 
perspective.

Transcend smirks. It looks like she's come 
up with an idea.

Later on, I spotted Transcend and Wonder 
Acute in the cafeteria.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
My, oh my! I've never seen pickles like 
these before~! What are they made of... 
Oh! This stewed dish has a wonderful aroma 
too!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
I ordered a bunch of different things~ 
Let's try them together and see how they 
taste♪

Wonder Acute marveled and enjoyed herself 
with every glance and every bite. It 
seemed my return gift was a great success.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
...Huh. Actually— it doesn't necessarily 
have to be a physical gift, right?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Hmm. In that case...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
I rented that period drama you love so 
much, Accu-san~!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Watching this while spending time with 
Accu-san. All relaxed and comfy.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
I thought maybe... we could chat from time 
to time and have a fun time together... or 
something.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
...How's this? Does it count as returning 
the favor?

When I tried to imagine it, Wonder Acute's 
delighted smile immediately came to mind.
choice_data_list:
I'll bring some snacks over as 
refreshments.

text_block_list.text:
Hearing those words brings a look of 
relief to Transcend's face. Transcend's 
gift in return is sure to go well.
